title: UC Davis Police Department
relevance: Official department homepage showing one police department with Davis and Sacramento contact points.
notes: Useful for tying the row to one department with two campus commands.

title: Davis Campus
relevance: Official statement that the Davis campus including UC properties in the city of Davis is patrolled 24/7 by UC Davis Police.
notes: Core source rejecting a Davis-city proxy while defining the Davis-side footprint.

title: Sacramento Campus
relevance: Official statement that the Sacramento campus including UC properties and surrounding areas is patrolled 24/7 by UC Davis Police.
notes: Core source proving the row is not Davis-only and requires a multi-campus treatment.

title: Transparency Dashboard
relevance: Official transparency page describing UC Davis Police reporting and campus-specific public-safety data.
notes: Supports the interpretation that public reporting is organized around Davis and Sacramento campus operations.

title: Crime and Safety Data
relevance: Official crime-data page referenced in search results as reporting criminal data from the department jurisdiction and providing separate Davis and Sacramento campus reporting outputs.
notes: Useful corroboration that the reporting geography is campus-centered rather than a municipal substitute.

title: Police Officer Careers
relevance: Official careers page referenced in search results as stating that officers serve the Davis and Sacramento campuses.
notes: Additional direct department evidence of the two-campus service structure.

title: About Law Enforcement
publisher: UC Davis Services for International Students and Scholars
relevance: Official UC Davis page telling readers they may see UC Davis Police on campus, Davis Police around town in Davis, and Sacramento Police in Sacramento.
notes: Best official source for distinguishing campus policing from adjacent municipal policing.

title: Getting to UC Davis
relevance: Official statement that the Davis campus is a 5,300-acre campus bordering the City of Davis.
notes: Strong source against equating the campus with the whole city.

title: Office of Environmental Planning Home
publisher: UC Davis Office of Environmental Planning
relevance: Official page stating UC Davis CEQA work covers the Davis campus, Sacramento Health campus, and all off-campus locations.
notes: Useful for distinguishing the two campuses from the broader institution.

title: Sacramento Campus
publisher: UC Davis Office of Environmental Planning
relevance: Official page stating UC Davis operates two campus locations, the 5,300-acre Davis campus and 150-acre Sacramento campus, and that UC Davis Health also has dozens of off-campus facilities.
notes: Key source for the two-campus footprint and for rejecting a whole-institution proxy.

title: Maps
publisher: Locations and Parking for Patients and Visitors of UC Davis Health
notes: Official UC Davis Health page describing the 150-acre Sacramento campus and separately noting 17 neighborhood clinics across multiple counties.
column9: Helps separate the bounded Sacramento campus from the broader clinic network.

title: UC Davis Sacramento Campus Map
relevance: Official campus map and guide listing the buildings and services on the Sacramento campus.
notes: Best map-style source for the Sacramento campus footprint component.

title: 2024 UC Davis Annual Security and Fire Safety Report
relevance: Official Clery report stating the report applies to both the Davis and UCD Health campuses and tracks on-campus, adjacent public property, and certain off-campus university-controlled property.
notes: Useful corroboration that UC Davis public safety reporting is structured around both campuses.

title: California Education Code Section 92600
relevance: Official statute granting UC police authority on UC campuses, within one mile of campus boundaries, and on other Regents property.
notes: Important legal backdrop, but broader than the routine production geometry.

title: California Penal Code Section 830.2
relevance: Official statute recognizing UC police as peace officers with primary duty tied to Education Code section 92600.

title: FBI CDE Agency Roster 2024
relevance: Local repo evidence that CA0579700 is the active FBI roster row for University of California: Davis and is anchored administratively in Davis/Yolo.
notes: Useful repo-side evidence that the place and county anchors are roster anchors rather than proved footprint geometry.

title: LEAIC Crosswalk ICPSR 35158
relevance: Local repo evidence for the single UC Davis police ORI and its Davis administrative address.

title: Project Tracker
relevance: Local repo note that earlier high-tier overlap review had already escalated CA0579700 because official police coverage spans Davis and Sacramento campuses.
notes: Useful project-memory evidence that the simple place proxy had already failed verification.
